name: Kalibo Bridge III
facts: Kalibo Bridge III stretches 770 meters, making it one of the longest two-lane bridges in Aklan, and it carries the Kalibo Circumferential Road over the Aklan River.
Inaugurated on January 16, 2020, Kalibo Bridge III opened its lanes to motorists, marking a milestone for regional connectivity and easing travel between Kalibo and Lezo.
As part of the Kalibo Circumferential Road, Kalibo Bridge III serves as a critical artery, linking the municipality of Kalibo with neighboring Lezo and supporting local commerce.
